in_sanskrit.name: Omiansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God's Abode
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Omiansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Omiansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Om' and 'Ansh'. 'Om' is the sacred syllable in Hinduism representing the ultimate reality. 'Ansh' means abode. Therefore, Omiansh can be interpreted as the abode or residence of the Moon God. In Hindu mythology, the Moon God is often depicted as a powerful deity who governs the tides and the mind. Thus, Omiansh is a name that conveys a deep spiritual connection to the lunar cycles and the natural world.
